newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PolyGram profits slip in first quarter 1997.
newsitem.headline: PolyGram profits slip in first quarter 1997.

text.p: Music and entertainment group PolyGram NV reported a slight dip in first quarter 1997 profits to 122 million guilders ($63.7 million), down from 124 million in the first quarter of 1996.

The results reflected the differing fortunes of its music and filmed entertainments units. Operating profits in the music division marched ahead to 251 million guilders from 211 million but in the film unit, losses deepened to 55 million guilders from 19 million in the first quarter of 1996.
"Music activities improved during the quarter, whereas film was weak, primarily due to the underperformance of new releases," PolyGram said in a statement.
Overall sales rose to 2.20 billion guilders from 2.03 billion. A strong dollar and sterling had a positive effect on sales, it added.
These are the first quarterly results to be published by the company. ($ = 1.914 Dutch Guilders)
